indirect_contracts.contract: Registers map_async in after_submit. Failed submission must not execute callback. Pending object has no automatic submit-failed state; caller must propagate submit Err rather than continue polling Pending.
Consumes batch through read_word and returns a new open batch. read_words error propagation must stop dependent sizing/publication; no complete card result on failed count submission.
Publishes shaped cache after recording, before native finish. Shape cache is reused across calls.
Updates current before recording and have_before afterward, still before submit. They select persistent previous/current sample buffers.
Caches source upload, not a completed garment dispatch. Later unrelated batch failure does not itself invalidate source data.
Compilation/source-cache success is distinct from recorded execution success. Failed external dispatch must not indiscriminately evict a successfully built canonical pipeline.
